styles.name: Qamariya Towers

massing.stack_rules: slim free-standing towers; the top storey (mafraj) steps in 0.6 m with windows on three sides; walls batter 2-3% inward; a dark stone base 1-2 storeys

styles.floor_plan: A-P1 tower_house (plans/a_plans.md)
styles.fantasy: every tower a stained-glass lantern at night: the coloured qamariya arcs are the island's signature

styles.name: Shibam Stack

refs.title: UNESCO 192 Old Walled City of Shibam

massing.stack_rules: a tight grid of tapering towers 2-4 m apart, all nearly the same height (a city-wall skyline); the lowest 2 storeys blind (stores and stalls inside); windows grow with height; white crowns

styles.floor_plan: A-P1 tower_house in a dense grid; bridges at storeys 4-6
styles.fantasy: the 'Manhattan of the desert' as a warren: a cliff of towers with rope-and-plank bridges, laundry and bulbs strung between

styles.name: Roshan Quarter

refs.title: Al Balad, the jewel of Jeddah
House of Saud: Jeddah coral architecture

massing.stack_rules: the roshans project 0.6-0.9 m and stack floor over floor, often merging into a continuous screen 2-3 storeys tall; a flat timber cornice; tie-beam bands every metre of height

styles.floor_plan: A-P1 with roshans on floors 2..n; the stair in a back lightwell
styles.fantasy: whole facades of glowing lattice: at night each roshan is a lantern box with a silhouette behind the screen

styles.name: Wikala Market Courts

massing.stack_rules: a four-sided block round a paved court: a 2-storey arcade of stores below, a gallery of duplex flats above; one monumental gate with a muqarnas hood; minaret-like sign masts at the corners

styles.floor_plan: A-P3 market_court (wikala + rab')
styles.fantasy: the merchants' inn as the heart of a trading island: the court roofed by a canopy of bulb festoons and hanging fanous lanterns

styles.name: Riad Terraces

massing.stack_rules: inward courtyard blocks with near-blank street walls; the upper floors step back round a deep court; a menzeh belvedere tower on one corner; roof terraces linked

styles.floor_plan: A-P2 courtyard (bent entry); a street-front ring of shops
styles.fantasy: courts glowing up out of the roofscape like lanterns set in the deck; pierced-brass star light thrown on the walls

styles.name: Falaj Forts

refs.title: Peregrine: Oman's traditional villages and forts
Scott Dunn: Nizwa Fort and Al Hamra

massing.stack_rules: sturdy battered blocks with triangular crenellations; a round crenellated tower per cluster (the clan tower); open falaj water channels running between buildings to the ponds

styles.floor_plan: a courtyard house (A-P2 variant) with a corner tower
styles.fantasy: the clan's round tower lit from below like a lighthouse; water channels lit along their edges

styles.name: Ablaq Lanes
sources: Damascus and Aleppo old cities, Syria

massing.stack_rules: blank striped-stone ground floors; jettied timber upper storeys overhanging the lanes 0.5-1.2 m; sabat rooms bridging the lanes; an iwan facing each court

styles.floor_plan: A-P2 with an iwan; the upper floor jettied over the lane
styles.fantasy: lanes roofed by overhanging rooms and bridges: a tunnel of warm windows

styles.name: Roofstreet Oasis

refs.title: Archnet: Restoration and Revival of the Shali Fortress
CNR: The salt architecture in Siwa oasis

massing.stack_rules: a continuous mass of terraced houses with covered alleys under them; ALL roofs joined into one walkable plain with little bridges over the light shafts; soft rounded salt-and-clay parapets; the roofs are the island's main street

styles.floor_plan: A-P7 roof_street
styles.fantasy: a second town on the roofs: market stalls, gardens and lark cradles on a white plain, the alleys below glowing out of the light shafts

styles.name: Pueblo Blanco

massing.stack_rules: whitewashed cubes stepping up the island's rolling hills; patio houses; rejas on every window; a bell-tower landmark on the highest point

styles.floor_plan: a Córdoba patio house (A-P2 variant): zaguán, patio, a 2-storey gallery
styles.fantasy: feria nights: gateway arches built of thousands of bulbs over the lanes

styles.name: Mudéjar Brickworks

massing.stack_rules: brick blocks crowned by square towers covered in geometric brick relief and green-and-white glazed inlays; arcaded loggias on the top floor

styles.floor_plan: a block with a central lightwell; the loggia on the top floor
styles.fantasy: glazed towers that glitter green when lit from below

styles.name: Hanging Houses

refs.title: Sacyr: a house that hangs from a cliff

massing.stack_rules: a ring of houses along the island rim, a third of each cantilevered past the fence over the drop on timber brackets; long timber galleries on two or three levels facing out; masonry base, timber upper storeys

styles.floor_plan: A-P9 rim_hanger
styles.fantasy: seen from below and afar, a rim of lit balconies hanging over nothing: a necklace round the island

styles.name: Modernista Reef
sources: Barcelona: Casa Batlló, Casa Milà, Eixample

refs.title: Gaudí's Casa Batlló and Casa Milà

massing.stack_rules: chamfered-corner blocks round garden courts; undulating facade bands; bone-like piers on the principal floor; a scaled dragon-back roof edge; a roofscape of mosaic chimneys and vent sculptures you can walk among

styles.floor_plan: A-P8 chamfer_block
styles.fantasy: a coral reef of a roof: the mosaic chimneys lit in cycling colours like anemones

styles.name: Balcón Canario
sources: La Orotava and La Laguna, Canary Islands

massing.stack_rules: rendered blocks with long covered timber balconies on turned posts along whole floors; glazed galerías on the cold (windward) faces; deep eaves on brackets

styles.floor_plan: a courtyard block; the balconies run the full facade
styles.fantasy: the galerías as warm glass cabinets against the snow (they suit the cold aloft)

styles.name: Haveli Bazaar

refs.title: Inside the disappearing havelis of Chandni Chowk

massing.stack_rules: courtyard havelis behind continuous shopfronts; jharokhas on brackets at every bay of the upper floors; a chhajja over every storey; jali parapets; chhatri pavilions at the roof corners (one is the stair head); later brick additions bolted on top

styles.floor_plan: A-P4 haveli
styles.fantasy: a market lane by night: cascades of tiny bulbs down every facade, chaser borders on every arch, a hundred stacked signs

styles.name: Mughal Crown
sources: Red Fort and Jama Masjid, Delhi

refs.title: Inside the disappearing havelis of Chandni Chowk

massing.stack_rules: symmetrical blocks on a raised plinth; tall arched portals (pishtaq); a crown of onion domes and chhatris; charbagh courts with the ponds

styles.floor_plan: a courtyard civic block (halls, infirmaries, schools: the canon's institutions)
styles.fantasy: domes outlined in bulbs, reflected in the island's ponds

styles.name: Chawl Galleries

refs.title: The Book Review: Through the prism of a structure

massing.stack_rules: long slabs of single rooms on open galleries; one repeated 3 m bay; stair and wc cores at the ends; galleries hung with laundry, plants and lanterns; terraces on top for parties and kites

styles.floor_plan: A-P5 gallery_block
styles.fantasy: every gallery a ribbon of lit doors and lanterns: a striped cliff of light

styles.name: Marine Deco
sources: Mumbai Art Deco: the Oval, Marine Drive

refs.title: UNESCO: Victorian Gothic and Art Deco Ensembles of Mumbai
India Seminar: Art Deco in Mumbai
Google Arts & Culture: Art Deco Bombay

massing.stack_rules: streamlined blocks with curved corner balconies; eyebrow sunshades over the windows; a zig-zag or ziggurat crown on corner buildings; 'flying saucer' roof terraces; the building's name in relief letters

styles.floor_plan: a block with a central lightwell; flats round it; a corner shop
styles.fantasy: the Queen's Necklace in the sky: pastel blocks outlined in neon, rooftop letter signs

styles.name: Saracenic Gothic
sources: Mumbai CSMT, Rajabai Tower, Gateway of India

massing.stack_rules: polychrome Gothic blocks with a central dome or clock tower; pointed and cusped arcades; chhatris and pinnacles at every corner; deep chhajja eaves

styles.floor_plan: a civic courtyard block: a station, market hall or clan hall
styles.fantasy: the island's hall floodlit in slowly cycling colours (as CSMT is projection-mapped)

styles.name: Toolhouse Stack

refs.title: urbz: Resilience and recognition of an unseen typology

massing.stack_rules: tiny plots; each storey re-rolls its colour, material and window type and may cantilever 0.3-0.6 m over the lane; a bolt-on steel stair per storey; a workshop on the ground floor; sheds, drums and coops on every roof; storey height 2.7

styles.floor_plan: A-P6 warren_stack
styles.fantasy: the Ghibli bathhouse rule: additions on additions, every one lit differently

styles.name: Konkan Cottages

massing.stack_rules: rows of brightly painted timber houses; a big overhanging first-floor balcony; external spiral or latticed teak stairs to the upper rooms and roof; verandahs

styles.floor_plan: row houses 1-2 rooms deep; an external stair to the balcony and roof
styles.fantasy: Christmas in Khotachiwadi all year: a star lantern at every balcony

styles.name: Festoon Bazaar
sources: Mohammed Ali Road and Bhendi Bazaar, Mumbai

refs.title: Inside the disappearing havelis of Chandni Chowk

massing.stack_rules: Bohri-style blocks with stacked fretwork timber and cast-iron balconies over continuous shopfronts; a minaret or sign mast at lane ends; the lanes roofed by bulb festoons strung facade to facade

styles.floor_plan: shops on the ground floor, 3-5 flats above round a lightwell; stairs at the back
styles.fantasy: the brightest market of the Skein: festoons over every lane, a canyon of neon

styles.name: Moorish Deco (hybrid)
sources: Hybrid: Marine Drive Deco + the Alhambra/Fez + Indo-Saracenic

refs.title: UNESCO: Victorian Gothic and Art Deco Ensembles of Mumbai
India Seminar: Art Deco in Mumbai
Google Arts & Culture: Art Deco Bombay

massing.stack_rules: streamlined Deco blocks whose crowns are stepped horseshoe-arched lanterns and small domes; zellij bands in place of Deco relief; curved balconies with lattice screens

styles.floor_plan: a Deco block with a lightwell
styles.fantasy: the Skein's own style: two ports' worth of ornament on one streamlined body

styles.name: Jharokha Towers (hybrid)
sources: Hybrid: Sana'a tower houses + Delhi jharokhas + the Hawa Mahal screen

refs.title: Inside the disappearing havelis of Chandni Chowk

massing.stack_rules: slim towers whose every bay on every floor carries a jharokha with a tiny chhatri roof, the facade becoming a honeycomb of oriels (the Hawa Mahal effect); bridges between the towers at mid height

styles.floor_plan: A-P1 tower_house with a jharokha in every bay
styles.fantasy: a pink tower made entirely of glowing bay windows

styles.name: Ghorfa Honeycomb
sources: Ksar Ouled Soltane and the ghorfa ksour, southern Tunisia

massing.stack_rules: barrel-vaulted cells (2.8 x 6 x 2.4) stacked 4-7 tiers round one or two courts; vault ends make a honeycomb facade; NO inner stairs: steep external stairs, beam-steps and plank landings on every tier; a gate tower

styles.floor_plan: A-P10 ghorfa_court (plans/a_plans_north_africa.md)
styles.fantasy: a honeycomb of shops round a court: at night every vault door a cell of light, the court roofed with festoons

styles.name: Tighremt Towers
sources: Aït Benhaddou and the Draa/Dades kasbahs, Morocco

massing.stack_rules: square blocks with four lean corner towers rising 1-2 storeys above the body, tapering 4-6%; blind lower walls; geometric relief on the top third; the roof terrace between the towers is a garden; clustered up hills like a ksar

styles.floor_plan: A-P11 tighremt
styles.fantasy: a ksar of red towers; each tower top a beacon and sign mast

styles.name: Ghardaïa Cascade
sources: Ghardaïa and the M'zab pentapolis, Algeria

massing.stack_rules: rings of hand-shaped cubes stepping up the island's hill to a truncated pyramidal minaret at the top; each house a covered court with a roof grille and an arcaded roof loggia facing out; the arcaded market square at the foot

styles.floor_plan: A-P12 hill_cone
styles.fantasy: a whole hill of pastel cubes lit in rings like a wedding cake, a lit pyramid at the top

styles.name: Matmata Pits

massing.stack_rules: round pit courts 8-14 m across sunk 6-9 m into the deck, rooms carved round them on two levels, joined by tunnels; light buildings and gardens over the rooms; a canopy rim round each pit

styles.floor_plan: A-P13 pit_court
styles.fantasy: seen from above at night, glowing round holes in the island, strung across with lights

styles.name: Chefchaouen Blue

massing.stack_rules: whitewashed-and-blue houses up stepped lanes on the hills; inner courts; red-tile eaves; blue stairs and doors; pots everywhere

styles.floor_plan: a courtyard house (A-P2 variant) on stepped lanes
styles.fantasy: an island washed blue: warm lamps on blue walls, the strongest colour contrast in the Skein

styles.name: Medina Warren

massing.stack_rules: courtyard houses sharing party walls along lanes 1.2-3 m wide; mashrabiyas and jetties almost meet over the lanes; sabat rooms bridge the lane every 20-40 m; a vaulted covered souk street through the ground floors of a row; roofs at mixed heights joined by ladders and planks

styles.floor_plan: A-P14 medina_warren
styles.fantasy: lanes so narrow the upper floors nearly touch: a canyon of lattice and lanterns, the souk a tunnel of light
